summary: The root مَشِيجٌ (mashīj) refers to something mixed or confused, like two colors or substances blended.
lane: مَشِيجٌ ذ (S, K) and (K) and like كتف in its two dial. forms, ( فِى لُغَتَيْهِ , K accord. to the TA,) i. e., and , or like كَتِفٌ in a dial. of little authority, ( فِى لُغَيَّةٍ , CK and a MS. copy of the K.) [See مَشْيُوحَآءُ , in art. شيج .] A thing mixed, or confused: (S, K:) or any two things mixed together: or any two colours mixed together: or what is a mixture of red and white: (TA:) pl. (of all the above forms, TA) أَمْشَاجٌ . (S, K.) -b2- نُطْفَةٌ أَمْشَاجٌ , occurring in the Kur, lxxvi. 2, [ A drop consisting of ] mixtures; meaning the sperma genitale, because it is a mixture of various kinds: (ISk:) or [ a drop consisting of ] mixtures of sperma genitale and blood: (Zj:) or [ a drop consisting of ] the sperma genitale of the man mixed with that of the woman and with her blood. (S, K.) -b3- Also أَمْشَاجٌ What collect together in the navel. (K.)

headwords.def: aor. مَشُجَ, inf. n. مَشْجٌ, He mixed, or confused, syn. خَلَطَ, (K,) one thing with ( بِ ) another. (TK.) مَشَجَ بَيْنَهُمَا He made a confusion, or disturbance, ( خَلَطَ,) between them two. (S.)
and مَشَجٌ and مَشِجٌ: see مَشِيجٌ.

[See مَشْيُوحَآءُ, in art. شيج.] A thing mixed, or confused: (S, K:) or any two things mixed together: or any two colours mixed together: or what is a mixture of red and white: (TA:) pl. (of all the above forms, TA) أَمْشَاجٌ. (S, K.) نُطْفَةٌ أَمْشَاجٌ, occurring in the Kur, lxxvi.

headword_note: Lane organises by verb form and principal noun, not by every inflected form. A word with no headword entry falls back to the root meaning; nothing is inferred.
